Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning fingerprint-based background checks for stateregistered appraiser trainee applicants and existing credential holders.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to fingerprint-based background checks for stateregistered appraiser trainee applicants and existing credentialholders; amending RCW 18.140.060 and 18.140.120; and adding a newsection to chapter 18.140 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 18.140.060 and 2005 c 339 s 5 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Applications for examinations, original certification,licensure, or registration, and renewal certification, licensure, orregistration shall be made in writing to the department on formsapproved by the director. Applications for original and renewalcertification, licensure, or registration shall include a statementconfirming that the applicant shall comply with applicable rules andregulations and that the applicant understands the penalties formisconduct. (2) The appropriate fees shall accompany all applications forexamination, reexamination, original certification, licensure, orregistration, and renewal certification, licensure, or registration. p. 1 SHB 1740 (3) Each applicant for registration as a stateregistered appraisertrainee and each applicant seeking to change the level of his or hercredential must submit to a background investigation under section 3 ofthis act. (4) Qualified applicants for licensure or certification fromanother jurisdiction not requiring trainee registration shall submit toa background investigation under section 3 of this act. (5) At the discretion of the director, existing credential holdersmay by rule be required to submit to background investigations undersection 3 of this act at renewal.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 18.140.120 and 2005 c 339 s 9 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: An applicant for certification or licensure who is currentlycertified or licensed and in good standing under the laws of anotherstate may obtain a certificate or license as a Washington statecertified or statelicensed real estate appraiser without beingrequired to satisfy the examination requirements of this chapterif((:)) the director determines that ((the certification or licensurerequirements are substantially similar to those found in Washingtonstate; and that the other state has a written reciprocal agreement toprovide similar treatment to holders of Washington state certificatesand/or licenses)): The appraiser licensing and certification programof the other state is in compliance with 12 U.S.C. 3351(b); and theother state's requirements for certification or licensing meet orexceed the licensure standards established in this chapter.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 18.140 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Effective January 1, 2015, background investigations under thischapter consist of fingerprintbased background checks through theWashington state patrol criminal identification system and through thefederal bureau of investigation. The applicant is required to pay thecurrent federal and state fees for fingerprintbased criminal historybackground checks. The applicant shall submit the fingerprint cardsand required fees for background checks to the department for SHB 1740 p. 2 submission to the Washington state patrol.
